# Refund policy

Refunds are issued within 14 days of the request being approved by a named
approver. The approver must be someone other than the agent who resolved the
ticket.

## Amounts

A refund over $2,400.00 is escalated to finance before it is issued. Anything
at or below that amount is issued by the desk directly.

## Records

Every refund cites the invoice it reverses. Invoice INV-2024-113 is the worked
example used throughout the handbook.
